trigger: purchase of the program or the bundle (tag: 30days-buyer)
rules: Send daily lessons at 7:00 in the subscriber’s time zone; the subscriber can pause or change the time.
Stop the free funnel (funnel/) for anyone who buys.
Never collect or merge a child’s name. Birth month and year only, and only on the free sign-up.
Every email is finished text: no founder input is needed before loading (make.sh --final checks that no placeholder remains).

merge_tags.{{logo_url}}: hosted PNG of brand/logo/png/lockup-horizontal-2400.png (upload once to the email platform)
merge_tags.{{workbook_download_link}}: expiring download link for the workbook files
merge_tags.{{feedback_form_link}}: one-question form (which play did your child go back to?)
merge_tags.{{business_mailing_address}}: the public business mailing address from legal/ENTITY.md (a USPS PO Box; CAN-SPAM). Most platforms insert it from the account settings: map this tag to that field, or to the platform footer

emails.preheader: Describing what your child is doing gives them words without asking them to perform.

emails.preheader: When your child says or shows something, say it back and add one more word or idea.

emails.preheader: Songs, rhymes and gestures make words easy to join in with, in any language.
